spanish: Y les advertirás a ellos los estatutos y las leyes, y les harás conocer a ellos el camino, andarán en él, y la obra que harán.
grammarChanges: Replaced the untranslated lemma 'las torás' with the Spanish common noun 'las leyes' for הַתּוֹרֹ֑ת (H8451, definite feminine plural), paired with the existing 'los estatutos'.
Added clitic pronoun doubling ('les ... a ellos') on both verbs so the direct/indirect object pronouns agree with standard Spanish syntax; participants and who acts on whom are unchanged.
Added a comma after 'el camino' before the asyndetic clause 'andarán en él' for Spanish punctuation, keeping the relator-less structure that matches the Hebrew tokens.
readerNote: Kept 'en él' as-is: Spanish 'camino' is grammatically masculine, so 'él' is required even though the Hebrew suffix is feminine; the referent (the way) does not change.
